decision.rationale: Numerical fits on action-2 plus initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 give BIC linear -2341 vs quadratic_loss -2329 vs sensor_lag -2279; training fit cannot establish mechanism or future accuracy. action-2 sustained 0.6/0.6 shows no_mismatch_observed probe RMSE 0.086 only for that input. Propose both-release diagnostic to independently test initial model on heating then release transient not yet covered.
